messages:
Rebecca (CS): FYI Halcyon private cutover - audit logs stopped arriving after their CMK rotation last night. Renewal review Friday; they want proof of delivery before we talk pricing.

Matt (CS): Ouch. Can you paste the forwarder error and bucket name so infra can triage?

Rebecca (CS): Forwarder error 2026-03-20T23:12Z:
``ERROR PutObject 403 AccessDenied; cause: KMS:Encrypt failed for key arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:210000111222:key/rot-9f8e7d6c``
Bucket: halcyon-logs-prod (acct 210000111222)

Deepak (Infra): Likely two things: (1) our forwarder role arn:arn:aws:iam::987654321098:role/rdw-forwarder-prod lacks kms:Encrypt on the new key, (2) Halcyon's key policy doesn't allow cross-account encrypt. Also their S3 bucket policy blocks PutObject from external principals.

Lee (Ops): Which principal should we request? We can push a short grant.

Rebecca (CS): Customer confirmed rotated key arn above and said old key was disabled for 4h. Isabelle (Halcyon) is on thread.

Isabelle (Halcyon): We did a staged rotation. Sorry for the outage; we can grant a short-term exception if you document steps.

Deepak (Infra): Proposed minimal key policy snippet (will open PR):
``- Sid: AllowForwarderEncrypt
  Effect: Allow
  Principal: arn:aws:iam::987654321098:role/rdw-forwarder-prod
  Action: ["kms:Encrypt","kms:GenerateDataKey"]
  Resource: arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:210000111222:key/rot-9f8e7d6c
``
Plus a one-off CreateGrant to speed recovery. Also note we should ask customers to pre-warm grants during rotation in runbook.

Lee (Ops): Applying grant and role policy now. Command: `aws kms create-grant --key-id rot-9f8e7d6c --grantee-principal arn:aws:iam::987654321098:role/rdw-forwarder-prod --operations Encrypt GenerateDataKey`

deploy-bot: pipeline/rdw-forwarder-prod v4.1 build 912 started
deploy-bot: pipeline/rdw-forwarder-prod v4.1 build 912 passed

Lee (Ops): Rolled role + grant, restarted forwarder. Monitoring.

Rebecca (CS): I've scheduled a quick enablement with Isabelle & their infra for tomorrow 11:00 PT to demo the rotation play and capture screenshots.

Lee (Ops): Forwarder logs now show PutObject 200 and KMS GenerateDataKey SUCCESS :tada:

Deepak (Infra): Grant + key policy patch merged. Added runbook blurb to PR: steps to rotate CMK without downtime (pre-grant, stagger disable, validate S3/CW logs, revoke grants).

Matt (CS): Created CS-4501 to track evidence (S3 access logs + CloudTrail event) and rotate-howto doc. Marked renewal-risk=medium until evidence attached.

Isabelle (Halcyon): Posted CloudTrail snippet and S3 access log lines showing PutObject from our forwarder at 23:19:40 UTC. Also requested a short 1-pager on safe rotations.

Rebecca (CS): Attached 1-pager to CS-4501 and recorded the enablement session; uploading now. Updating renewal-risk=low.

Matt (CS): I'll add a note in the account playbook about recommending pre-grant during rotations for all upcoming privates.

Rebecca (CS): Closing the operational loop. Thanks team. Isabelle, let us know if you'd like a walkthrough of the runbook edits.

Isabelle (Halcyon): All good on our side. Appreciate the fast turnaround. Marking as resolved.
